candidates.claim: sw-core-01 has a routed VLAN interface Vlan10 with IP address 10.10.10.254/24, an SVI for zone VLAN 10 that the policy forbids.
candidates.remediation: Remove the IP address from interface Vlan10 on sw-core-01 so that VLAN 10 is routed only by fw-01.

candidates.claim: Interface Vlan10 on sw-core-01 was added relative to the approved baseline and is not in the baseline.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added interface Vlan10 on sw-core-01 with the approved baseline, either approving it or removing it.

candidates.claim: An ip address line in interface Vlan10 on sw-core-01 was added relative to the approved baseline.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added ip address on interface Vlan10 of sw-core-01 with the approved baseline, either approving it or removing it.

candidates.claim: The global command ip routing on sw-core-01 was added relative to the approved baseline.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added ip routing setting on sw-core-01 with the approved baseline, either approving it or disabling it.

Which route is active, and is the route via 10.10.99.1 an approved path? Traffic between MGMT and other zones must use only approved services.
